description: This is the main entry point source file for the rusEfi ECU console application. It defines the Launcher class which initializes the GUI, manages connection states, loads configurations, and handles application startup and shutdown sequences.

classes.name: Launcher
classes.description: Main class responsible for initializing and starting the rusEfi ECU console application, managing GUI, connection states, configurations, and application lifecycle.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point, handles command-line arguments, initializes configuration, and launches the GUI.

methods.name: awtCode
methods.description: Initializes GUI components after ensuring the AWT event dispatch thread is ready.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Updates the main window's title based on connection and firmware status.

methods.name: windowOpenedHandler
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when the window is opened, such as updating UI based on connection status.

methods.name: windowClosedHandler
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations when the window is closed, such as saving configuration and closing connections.
